news.headline: Is Intel Stock Too Dependent On One Big Bet?
news.summary: Intel (INTC) expects its capital spending to be more than $20 billion in 2026. That money goes into chip plants and tools. Intel's operations produced $14.9 billion of cash over the last twelve months. Its 2026 plan costs more than the cash its operations brought in over the past year, so the new plants need to pay off. So is Intel stock too dependent on that spending paying off.

news.summary: One business stands out at Intel (INTC): the chips it sells for data center servers, and that's what Intel bulls might be betting on.
